faith.heading: Statement of Faith
faith.toggle: Read our full statement of faith
faith.mission: Rise Up Queens is a Christian movement built on the unshakable truth of the Gospel. We believe salvation through Jesus is the starting point for true freedom, and the journey doesn’t stop there. Our mission is to lead women into a life-changing relationship with God, where they receive His grace and walk boldly in their sanctification, growing in strength, identity, and purpose every day.
faith.label: Statement of Faith
faith.title: Rise Up Queens Statement of Faith
faith.intro: Rise Up Queens is a movement founded on the Christian faith. It is our core spiritual conviction that the Christian faith provides people an opportunity to be saved, and to be spiritually reborn. Our work as a movement is largely about leading women to embrace the grace-gift of salvation, and to engage more deeply in their process of sanctification so they can live with strength!
beliefs: The Bible is the only inspired, infallible, authoritative Word of God, and is trustworthy as the foundation for life, practice, and conduct.
There is one God, eternally existent in three persons – Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
People were created in the image of God, designed by God to experience eternal life.
Because of the Fall, all people have sinned and fall short of the glory of God, and need to be saved.
God made salvation possible for all people through the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ the only begotten Son of God.
God desires all people to be saved and this only comes through repentance and faith in Jesus Christ as Savior and Lord – salvation comes by grace through faith alone, not by works.
The Holy Spirit indwells all believers to give spiritual life, to guide personal and spiritual growth.

about.heading: Who is it for?
about.lead: Rise up Queens is for the woman who knows she has untapped potential. She desires to live in freedom while maximizing her impact within her family and community.
about.ctaHeading: Ready to Take the First Step?

faqs.q: Do I have to be married to attend?
faqs.a: No. While many women come to work on their marriage, this event is ultimately about you. We welcome single, engaged, divorced, and widowed women too.

faqs.q: What do we believe when it comes to faith?
faqs.a: Rise Up Queens is based on the non-denominational Christian faith. However, we have people attend from a wide variety of biblical-based religions.

faqs.q: Does my husband have to go to Rise Up Kings first?
faqs.a: No. While we encourage you both to take on this journey together, there is no prerequisite for this event.
Each of the 3 days has a spiritual, mental & physical component to it. This is an experiential event with over 10 experiences that are designed to transform a woman.

faqs.q: What is included in the ticket price?
faqs.a: We will cover meals and transportation during the event. You will be responsible for your hotel, meals outside the event times, and transportation to the hotel.
Please contact support@riseupqueens.com for more details

members.name: Jessica Lewis
bio: Jessica Lewis is a Christian marriage coach, speaker, and founder of Rise Up Queens—a transformational movement for high-achieving women who are tired of carrying it all and long to live in their God-given femininity.

Before Rise Up Queens, Jessica spent years living in quiet overdrive—building businesses, managing a household, and constantly striving to “do it right.” Behind closed doors, she battled burnout, resentment, and the ache of feeling emotionally disconnected in her own marriage. Her spiritual life felt dutiful, but dry. Her intimacy felt obligatory, not alive. And like many women, she felt pressure to stay strong while silently falling apart.

Everything shifted when Jessica began confronting the internal bricks that were blocking her joy, softness, and connection—with God, with her husband, and with herself. That journey led her to discover the power of biblical femininity, emotional healing, and raw vulnerability. Now, she helps other women do the same—guiding them into deeper intimacy, restored identity, and spiritual freedom.

Today, Jessica co-leads Rise Up Queens alongside her husband, Skylar Lewis (founder of Rise Up Kings), helping thousands of Christian couples transform their marriages from the inside out. Her work blends deep emotional healing with bold truth, combining biblical conviction, experiential learning, and a call to rise.

members.name: Molly Rhodes
bio: Molly Rhodes is a coach, speaker, and passionate leader with Rise Up Queens. After experiencing radical transformation through RUQ, she now devotes her life to helping women break free from the lies that keep them stuck. Trained in trauma integration, inner healing, and self-regulation therapies, Molly equips women to reclaim their true identity and walk in boldness and clarity. She knows the cost of living under the enemy’s lies—and now walks closely with women to help them rewrite their stories and live fully alive in God's purpose. If you’ve ever longed for someone to meet you in the hard, holy parts of life, Molly offers Spirit-led guidance with truth, compassion, and fire. A devoted prayer warrior and skilled coach, she lives in Dallas, Texas with her three boys and husband, Thomas.

members.name: Becky Hilty
bio: Hi, I’m Becky—wife of 16 years to my amazing husband, Robert, and mom to four wonderful kids: Amber, Sean, Savannah, and Jenni. I live in the wide-open beauty of Wyoming, where I’m a homemaker, business owner, and faith-based life coach with a heart for helping women live free from the pressure of performance.

Over the years, I’ve found deep joy in connecting with women—whether through conversation over coffee, moments of shared honesty, or walking through life’s challenges together. That love for truth, connection, and meaningful growth led me into coaching. Today, I have the privilege of walking alongside women as they rediscover their identity, set healthy boundaries, and step confidently into the life they were created for.

Whether I’m homeschooling my kids, managing our drive-thru coffee business, or sitting across from a woman in need of encouragement, I lead with intentionality, warmth, and grace. I’m passionate about helping others release perfectionism, rewrite the stories that have held them back, and live with purpose, clarity, and peace.

At the heart of everything I do is the desire to create space—where women feel seen, heard, and supported. A space where they can breathe deep, let go of pressure, and finally embrace the freedom of living with purpose and grace

members.name: Christy Tijerina
bio: Christy Tijerina was raised in a conservative Christian home and always dreamed of being a wife and mom—a dream that came true when she married her high school sweetheart at 18. Together, they had three children, all boys! She pursued nursing and became a registered nurse as part of a bigger dream they had together, to own their own business! They later built a plumbing business from their garage, that they have since sold. Christy now uses her experience to serve and support women as a coach with Rise Up Queens. Christy lives in Argyle, Texas with her family, including her shihtzu, Duke.

members.name: Natasha Seguin-Congrove
bio: Natasha is a RUQ coach dedicated to helping women break free from fear and control, and to build deeper, more fulfilling relationships within their families. Formerly she worked alongside her husband running multiple family businesses in South Carolina, Natasha experienced her own profound transformation through coaching, which inspired her to follow God’s calling and support other women on their journeys. As a mentor to girls in a Bible group, Natasha is passionate about creating safe, nurturing spaces where young women can be authentic and empowered. As a mother of four daughters, she understands the challenges women face in balancing family, faith, and personal growth.

Natasha’s coaching style is compassionate and collaborative, focused on helping women deepen relationships and experience true freedom in everyday life. She is committed to continuous personal development and believes that living in alignment with God’s purpose brings harmony to every area of life. Based in South Carolina, Natasha is devoted to guiding women toward greater purpose, connection, and fulfillment at home and beyond.

members.name: Maurie Shipp
bio: Above all, Maurie Shipp adores and follows her Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Without Him, nothing is possible! Maurie (pronounced “Marie”) knows the journey to and beauty of surrender; the surrender from self-driven pressure to perform and be perfect in the eyes of man. Prior to her own growth through Rise Up Queens, the Lord called her to serve women in their own walks. Maurie is passionate and enthusiastic. She knows the source of her joy and desires to help women move from the bondage of perfectionism to the peace of letting it all go. Maurie lives in College Station, Texas, with her husband, Dallas, and their three young children—Marlow, Bozeman, and Ryman. As a part-time homeschool teacher in their hybrid schooling, she’s learned a few things: God always delivers, the twisty crayons are better than the original ones, and grace given is oftentimes more important than giving the “right” answer.

members.name: Cyndi Cucchi
bio: Cyndi Cucchi has a natural gift for helping people feel seen, heard, and deeply known. Her warmth and authenticity create space for honest conversations, the kind where real transformation begins. Residing in Florida, Cyndi spent years in public education before becoming a homeschool mom and helping lay the foundation of her family’s business alongside her husband. Today, she walks alongside women as they move from striving and perfectionism into freedom in Christ, discovering lives marked by peace, purpose, and joy. Having walked through infertility and adoption herself, she holds a tender place in her heart for women navigating those journeys. She believes true freedom begins when women stop trying to be perfect and start living fully surrendered. At home, she is the wife of her high school sweetheart of 26 years and a mom of five, three girls bookended by two boys. She believes the most meaningful moments happen not on a stage, but around the table, in the everyday moments where faith is lived and hearts are changed.
members._source: Bio and photo supplied by Lance, 2026-10-02 (bio transcribed from the client screenshot).

members.name: Leticia Huddleston
bio: Leticia is a coach, wife and mom to four adventurous boys. The Lord is everything to her. From an early age, He became her refuge, her protector, her best friend, and the only place she consistently felt safe. Raised in a chaotic home marked by dysfunction, trauma, and survival, Leticia learned early how to live guarded: to distrust, suppress emotion, avoid conflict, and hold a tight grip on life in an effort to stay in control. It wasn’t until walking through seasons of deep pain, including divorce and a wilderness season of isolation, that everything began to shift. In that place, God drew her close, teaching her how to rest, rebuild trust, and live anchored in Him rather than in fear or her past. Through that journey, Leticia discovered that true freedom isn’t found in striving or control but in surrender, identity, and walking in the authority given through Christ. Now, Leticia walks alongside women who feel stuck, unworthy, unseen, and exhausted from carrying it all. Her coaching blends deep emotional awareness with biblical truth, creating a space that is both safe and transformative. She helps women create safety within themselves, rebuild trust, and step into a life marked by confidence, clarity, and peace: where they are no longer controlled by fear, but anchored in who they are in Christ.
members._source: Bio and photo supplied by Lance, 2026-10-02 (bio transcribed from the client screenshot).

members.name: Rachele Johnson
members._source: Bio and photo supplied by Lance, 2026-10-02 (bio transcribed from the client screenshot).

members.name: Lauren Swan
bio: Lauren Swan is a Christ-centered life coach who helps women move from breakthrough moments into lasting transformation. After experiencing the impact of Rise Up Queens in her own life, Lauren felt called to walk alongside women as they continue their healing, deepen their relationship with God, and stay anchored in the freedom they’ve found. Known for her empathy and spiritual discernment, Lauren creates a space where women feel safe to be fully seen and honest without judgment. She gently uncovers what’s beneath the surface and helps women recognize the patterns and beliefs keeping them stuck. Her approach is both compassionate and direct: she meets women where they are and calls them forward into truth, identity, and aligned action. With a background in education, psychology, coaching, and business ownership, Lauren connects deeply with women navigating leadership, family, and high levels of responsibility, especially those ready to lay down the pressure of holding it all together and step into greater freedom and authenticity. Her coaching is rooted in biblical truth and led by the Holy Spirit, with a focus on awareness, alignment, and lasting change. Lauren lives in Green Bay, Wisconsin with her husband Daniel and their four children, and is honored to serve as part of the RUQ community.
members._source: Bio and photo supplied by Lance, 2026-10-02 (bio transcribed from the client screenshot).

members.name: Courtenay Burkholder
bio: Courtenay is a wife of 20 years, a mom of four, and a coach with a deep heart for women walking through healing, personal growth, and restoration. After experiencing great loss, she understands what it’s like to carry pain quietly, how it can shape your marriage, your identity, and your relationship with God. Through her own journey, she’s experienced the freedom that comes from surrender, forgiveness, and letting God meet her in the hard places. Now, Courtenay is passionate about walking alongside women in all seasons of life as they process their stories, let go of what’s been weighing them down, and step into who they were created to be. She creates spaces where women can be real, feel supported, and experience true connection, with themselves, with others, and with God. Through coaching, community, and Rise Up Queens events, she invites women into that work every day. In this season of life, you’ll find Courtenay traveling with her family in a motorhome, homeschooling, exploring new places, and making memories along the way.

members.name: Adrianna Lewis
bio: Adrianna Lewis is a faith-based life and mindset coach devoted to helping women rise out of survival mode and step into the life God created for them. After becoming a mother at 17 and walking through addiction that led to homelessness and deep despair, Adrianna now lives in true freedom through Christ. Her life is a testament to what’s possible when you surrender, heal, and allow God to rebuild you from the inside out. Through her faith and her journey with Rise Up Queens, Adrianna didn’t just overcome anxiety, depression, fear, and control, she learned how to uproot what was driving them. That inner transformation gave her clarity, direction, and the confidence to fully walk in her God-given purpose. Now, she helps women who feel stuck, overwhelmed, or disconnected from themselves break free from emotional health struggles, rediscover their identity in Christ and gain clear vision for their life. Adrianna is known for guiding women beyond surface-level change into deep, lasting transformation, where healing happens at the root, not just the symptoms. If you’re ready to stop feeling lost and start living with clarity, peace, and purpose, Adrianna will walk with you every step of the way.
members._source: Bio and photo supplied by Lance, 2026-10-02 (bio transcribed from the client screenshot).

members.name: Jessica Barajas
bio: JB has lived the life you want to break free from. You’ve spent your life being the one who holds it all together while feeling like the one who was never quite chosen. That quiet ache and the feeling of being unseen even in a crowded room, of being unprotected in your own life ends here! I don’t do surface-level fixes. We go into the fire, to the very root of the shame that has tried to silence you, and we burn it away. This is about more than inspiration; it’s about a Holy Spirit-led reclamation of your soul. I’ve walked through the flames and come out free, and I’m reaching back to pull you through. When you are in this room, you are finally seen. You are finally known. And you are finally ready to walk in the terrifyingly beautiful power of who God says you are.
